messages:
sam: Quick sync request: LangChain + LlamaIndex partner asked to pilot a Gateway adapter flow routing to our Dedicated pools + an optional NimbleHW-accelerated on-prem image. They want a marketplace bundle (SaaS + AMI) and a joint announcement. Who can help scope technical & GTM?

elaine: I can do GTM outline. Need to know pilot KPIs (latency p50/p95, token cost targets, throughput). Also what's the lift to support LangChain Runner vs plain SDK?

devon: Tech notes: Gateway adapter supports LangChain via our runner shim already, but LlamaIndex needs a small mapping layer for document stores. For NimbleHW on-prem we need to validate quantized kernels. Est ETA ~3w for kernel tuning if hardware available.

sam: Pilot KPIs requested by partner: p95 < 600ms for 128 tokens, cost < $0.002/token equivalent, successful LlamaIndex vector upsert + query w/ cache hit rate > 80%.

tan: Ops checklist for marketplace: two SKUs (SaaS endpoint monthly, AMI license yearly), clear billing metering for reserved Dedicated usage, and a partner discount code. For AWS Marketplace we'll need seller account mapping and entitlement testing.

paula: Legal request: reseller language + co-marketing approval flow. @legal - can you provide a short template for SI bundles? :pray:

elaine: Co-announcement plan draft: 1) private 2-week preview with partner channels 2) joint blog + technical deep dive 3) webinar with partner + SI 4) marketplace tile live. Need comms owner from partner.

devon: Quick config sample we can share with partner to demo routing to Dedicated pool:
```bash
# enable gateway adapter pointing to dedicated pool
redwoodctl gateway create --name langchain-adapter --target dedicated://region-west/pool-small --enable-lambda-compat
```
Also share a manifest for LlamaIndex connector.

paula: Marketing asks: joint one-pager, co-branded architecture diagram, short demo script. I'll draft assets once product confirms bundle contents.

sam: Action items: devon -> hardware ETA + LlamaIndex mapping effort; tan -> SKU mapping + marketplace checklist; elaine -> draft co-announcement timeline; paula -> asset list; paula/legal -> co-marketing template. I'll book 30m tomorrow 11am PT to finalize.

market-eng-bot: Note: Marketplace tags suggested: "redwood-gateway","langchain","llamaindex","nimblehw","dedicated-reserve". Ensure AMI and SaaS manifests are attached.

devon: One blocker: partner needs a sandbox NimbleHW instance. I'll send partner a ticket requesting hardware access.

sam: Great, thanks all. If anyone hits blockers, put them here and I'll escalate to partnerships. :rocket:
